query: DataHub MCP and a read-only decision-evidence provider are connected. Tell me which signed decisions the running impact worker actually marked stale after the revenue column changed type, and whether DataHub writeback completed.
expected_behavior: Uses DataHub MCP for catalog discovery and exact entity retrieval
Uses deterministic receipt verification and persisted finding capabilities rather than reconstructing integrity or operational state with model judgment
Uses persisted campaign evidence when available and preserves workflow status, attempt count, DataHub writeback verification, policy version, and reason codes
Does not substitute prospective impact results for proof that the worker processed the event
Preserves the configured campaign scope, scan completeness, and truncation fields
Treats VERIFIED_AT_INGESTION, ARTIFACT_UNAVAILABLE, FAILED, and VERIFIED_NOW as distinct proof states
Does not call any mutation, quarantine, approval, replay execution, resolution, or supersession tool
Does not expose raw prompts, rows, tool payloads, receipt extensions, or model outputs
